note: Headquarters hub rooms for Depths of Vaelmoor (r46). The HQ is where the player loads after death. Each room has a kind, position, size, and NPCs.

rooms.name: The Keeper's Hall
rooms.description: A vast stone hall lit by soul-lanterns. The meta-progression tree glows on the far wall.

rooms.name: Brokk's Forge
rooms.description: Heat shimmers off an anvil the size of a horse. Brokk works in silence, sparks flying.

rooms.name: The Drowned Dock
rooms.description: A wooden dock over black water. Mira's maps hang from the ceiling, dripping.

rooms.name: The Raven's Perch
rooms.description: A circular room with a single chain hanging from the dark. Something swings on it.

rooms.name: The Memorial
rooms.description: Walls of names. Every run that ended here, remembered. Lena tends the stones.

rooms.name: The Descent
rooms.description: A spiral stair into the dark. The only way out is down.
